title: Token.identityRegistry points to IdentityRegistry
desc: Token must reference the IdentityRegistry used by ERC-3643 flow

title: IdentityRegistry wired with ClaimTopicsRegistry
desc: IdentityRegistry must point to the expected ClaimTopicsRegistry

title: Token transfers are KYC-gated (sanity)
desc: If IdentityRegistry is zero or missing getter, flag

title: Claim topics exist
desc: ClaimTopicsRegistry has at least one topic

title: IdentityRegistry wired with TrustedIssuersRegistry
desc: IdentityRegistry must point to the expected TrustedIssuersRegistry

title: Compliance module bound to token
desc: Token.compliance() must return the deployed compliance contract and it must be bound to the token

title: Token exposes setIdentityRegistry(address)
desc: Token must allow wiring/changing IdentityRegistry via an explicit admin/owner function

title: IdentityRegistry exposes setClaimTopicsRegistry(address)
desc: Admin should be able to update the ClaimTopicsRegistry reference

title: IdentityRegistry exposes setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)
desc: Admin should be able to update the TrustedIssuersRegistry reference

title: IdentityRegistry has isVerified(address)
desc: Transfers depend on verification; IdentityRegistry must expose isVerified(address) view

title: Token checks compliance hooks
desc: Token must expose compliance() getter and call canTransfer/created/destroyed/transferred hooks

title: Token has recovery / freeze controls
desc: Presence of recoveryAddress(), setAddressFrozen(), freeze/unfreeze partial tokens indicates recovery flows

title: Agent role management present
desc: Token exposes addAgent(address) and removeAgent(address) to manage privileged off-chain operations

title: IdentityRegistryStorage bound to IdentityRegistry
desc: IdentityRegistryStorage must include the active IR in its registries array (bindIdentityRegistry)

title: ClaimTopicsRegistry: add/remove/list topics
desc: CTR must expose addClaimTopic(uint256), removeClaimTopic(uint256), getClaimTopics()

title: TrustedIssuersRegistry: issuer/topic management
desc: TIR must expose addTrustedIssuer(address,uint256[]), removeTrustedIssuer(address), updateIssuerClaimTopics, getTrustedIssuersForClaimTopic

title: Ownable initializers called (non-zero owner)
desc: Owner of IdentityRegistry, ClaimTopicsRegistry, TrustedIssuersRegistry and Storage must be non-zero

title: Token decimals/name/symbol sane
desc: Token.decimals in [0..18] and non-empty name/symbol

title: ERC-20 surface present
desc: Token exposes standard ERC-20 functions: totalSupply, balanceOf, transfer, transferFrom, approve, allowance

title: Mint/Burn gated by compliance
desc: mint() and burn() reachable but expected to check identity/compliance; if ABI lacks these methods or hooks, flag

title: Zero-address checks on critical setters
desc: setIdentityRegistry, setCompliance, setOnchainID and similar setters should reject zero address

title: IdentityRegistry registration APIs present
desc: registerIdentity(address,IIdentity,uint16) and delete/update flows exist to manage investors

title: Compliance swap safe
desc: Token.setCompliance(address) exists and old compliance is unbound before binding the new one (as per T-REX)

title: Batch operations exist (optional)
desc: Batch transfer/forcedTransfer/mint/burn interfaces provided for operational efficiency

title: Events emitted for administrative actions
desc: Identity/issuer/topic updates and compliance changes emit events for auditability
